description: Shared cases for configured file path risk classification. A path is unbounded when it cannot be proven to stay inside the script workspace, which escalates a file action to a Dangerous permission. The editor and the runner must agree on every case, otherwise the risk shown at approval time differs from the risk the runner calculates and the package fails to import. Classification is platform independent because a package authored on one platform can be installed on the other.
